results.title: Russia Hits Ukraine's Energy Complex Objects Used for Armed Forces: MoD
results.description: The Russian armed forces have struck facilities of the Ukrainian energy complex in the Vinnitsa, Dnepropetrovsk and Kharkov regions providing military enterprises, the Russian Defence Ministry said on Tuesday.

results.title: Maryland replaced a 4-foot dam at Bishopville with pools and weirs, opening 7 miles of habitat; alewives were spotted upstream
results.description: A 4-foot dam in Bishopville, Maryland, was replaced with a natural stream channel, opening 7 miles of creek to spawning fish. Alewives have since been spotted.
